title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past
aliases: Zelda: A Link to the Past
shortDescription: A top-down adventure that turns parallel worlds, tools, and carefully paced dungeons into one exceptionally coherent quest.
highlights: The two-world structure gives exploration a strong sense of consequence
Dungeon tools reward observation instead of brute-force guessing
keywords: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A high-confidence SNES adventure anchor whose design remains welcoming without losing a sense of scale.
